title: Marbles: Ring and Shoot
tagline: Flick it. Clear the ring. Keep the king.
description: The playground marble game with real rolling glass. Pull back, flick your shooter, knock clay, glass and the golden king out of the ring, and outplay five rivals.
howToPlay: Tap the dotted line to place your shooter when it is in hand.
Pull back anywhere like a slingshot and let go to shoot.
Marbles that end outside the ring are yours: clay 1, glass 2, king 3.
Knock out two at once for a bonus shot; knock a rival shooter out of the ring to capture it.
The higher total after the last round wins.
